linesEn: Who dares...
disturb my slumber...?!
Impressive. True to your title as chieftain of the dragonewts,
you have finally tracked me down!

linesZhTw: 『你竟敢利用惡魔族來逞一己
的野心私欲，實在是不可原
linesZhCn: 『你竟敢利用恶魔族来逞一己
的野心私欲，实在是不可原
linesEn: You dare manipulate the demon race to serve your own selfish ambition!
You are utterly unforgivable!

linesZhTw: 『惡魔族本來就是我們創造的
事！而且，你既然知道了這
linesZhCn: 『恶魔族本来就是我们创造的
事！而且，你既然知道了这
linesEn: The demons were our creation to begin with!
How we use them is our concern alone. And now that you know...

linesZhTw: 些事，我就不會讓你活著離
linesZhCn: 些事，我就不会让你活着离
linesEn: ...I cannot let you leave this place alive!

linesZhTw: 『我手下的援軍馬上就趕到了
linesZhCn: 『我手下的援军马上就赶到了
linesEn: My reinforcements will be here any moment!
Today, you shall taste the might of dragonewt warriors...!
What a ferocious commotion...
Just what kind of reinforcements did you summon?
Wait... that doesn't sound like...
It finally stopped...

linesZhTw: 敵人交戰就摔掉半條命了…
linesZhCn: 敌人交战就摔掉半条命了…
linesEn: Ugh... What a terrible landing!
I feel half-dead before we've even crossed blades with the enemy...
Uni! Uni! Are you hurt?
I'm fine, not a scratch...
Are you alright too, Thor?
Hmph... Talk about favoritism!

linesZhTw: 裡好像就是敵方的根據地之
linesZhCn: 里好像就是敌方的根据地之
linesEn: Settle down, is everyone in one piece?
This appears to be an enemy stronghold. We must stay on high alert...

linesZhTw: 像有我們一族的龍人呢！』
linesZhCn: 像有我们一族的龙人呢！』
linesEn: Wait! There's a standoff over there...
Are those dragonewts from our clan?!
Really?! Then His Majesty must be there too!
Lord St. Colas!
Someone knows my name?
Ah! Banarossia and Kailas!
Your Majesty, we have finally found you!

linesZhTw: 想到會和你在這裡會師！』
linesZhCn: 想到会和你在这里会师！』
linesEn: St. Colas, it has been far too long.
I never imagined our paths would cross here!

linesZhTw: 啦，有你手下這批生力軍，
linesZhCn: 啦，有你手下这批生力军，
linesEn: Ah! Master Jonah! Splendid!
With these fresh reinforcements at your side, we have nothing to fear!

linesZhTw: 錯，你們都準備死在這裡吧
linesZhCn: 错，你们都准备死在这里吧
linesEn: Hmph! So they truly were your reinforcements.
Prepare to perish here together!
This monster sure talks big.
Ares, let's take him down together!
Right! Let's send him to join his three fallen brothers!

linesZhTw: 個魔神都已經被你們打倒了
linesZhCn: 个魔神都已经被你们打倒了
linesEn: What?! Could it be... the Earth, Water, and Wind Demon Gods have all fallen to you?!
Curse you! I, the Fire Demon God...

linesZhTw: 一併把這筆血債討回來！』
linesZhCn: 一并把这笔血债讨回来！』
linesEn: ...shall make you pay for their lives in blood!
Save your breath!
If you've got the guts, bring it on!

linesZhTw: 幫傢伙，要不然…這世界會
linesZhCn: 帮家伙，要不然…这世界会
linesEn: Jonah... You must take my place and strike down these fiends...
Otherwise... this world will...

linesZhTw: 的……到時候你們就會和這
linesZhCn: 的……到时候你们就会和这
linesEn: Curse you... Master will never forgive you...
When the time comes, you shall perish along with this world...
Lord St. Colas, forgive our late arrival!
You are not too late.
Strike down the Fire Demon God first!
At once!
What a perilous battle! Old Jonah, where did you find such fierce fighters?
Without them, the outcome of this clash...
...would have turned out very differently.

linesZhTw: 『他們是一群富正義感的年輕
勇士，因為機緣巧合同聚一
堂，之後為了打倒暗中威脅
linesZhCn: 『他们是一群富正义感的年轻
勇士，因为机缘巧合同聚一
堂，之后为了打倒暗中威胁
linesEn: They are a band of noble young warriors brought together by fate.
Together, we have fought to this day...

linesZhTw: 這整個大陸的敵人而和我一
linesZhCn: 这整个大陆的敌人而和我一
linesEn: ...to vanquish the shadowy threat looming over the entire continent.

linesZhTw: 一支夠強的軍隊！據我調查
的結果，這熔岩洞窟中有通
linesZhCn: 一支够强的军队！据我调查
的结果，这熔岩洞窟中有通
linesEn: Splendid! I was worried I wouldn't have time to muster an army strong enough.
According to my findings, a passage hidden within these magma caverns...

linesZhTw: 道通往一個古代人的遺跡，
據說從那裡可以直達黃金的
linesZhCn: 道通往一个古代人的遗迹，
据说从那里可以直达黄金的
linesEn: ...leads straight into ancient ruins, said to connect directly to the Golden Castle.
The Golden Castle? You mean that's the enemy's main stronghold?
Hard to say. We must investigate to know for certain.

linesZhTw: 『敵人似乎怕我們發現這一點
魔法讓火山爆發，徹底毀滅
linesZhCn: 『敌人似乎怕我们发现这一点
魔法让火山爆发，彻底毁灭
linesEn: The enemy seemed desperate to hide it.
That brute attempted to use magic to trigger a volcanic eruption and bury the route...

linesZhTw: 這條通道，但這樣也會毀了
惡魔族的棲息之地…幸好你
們及時抵達，才沒有讓那傢
linesZhCn: 这条通道，但这样也会毁了
恶魔族的栖息之地…幸好你
们及时抵达，才没有让那家
linesEn: ...even if it meant obliterating the demon homeland.
Fortunately, your timely arrival prevented him from succeeding.
His wicked scheme was thwarted just in time.

linesZhTw: 吧，這次絕不能再讓敵人搶
linesZhCn: 吧，这次绝不能再让敌人抢
linesEn: Excellent! Let's hurry to the ruins.
We can't let the enemy beat us to the punch this time!
Wait!
What? Did an enemy slip through the cracks?
Do not misunderstand! I have come to join your cause.
You can speak the tongue of humans?
Now this is fascinating.

linesZhTw: 『我是當今惡魔族之王卡爾根
的弟弟，王家魔法師亞奇梅
吉。我平日對人類和大陸上
linesZhCn: 『我是当今恶魔族之王卡尔根
的弟弟，王家魔法师亚奇梅
吉。我平日对人类和大陆上
linesEn: I am Archmage, royal sorcerer and brother to Calgen, King of the Demons.
I have long studied humankind and the other races of this continent...

linesZhTw: 的其他種族有很深的研究，
linesZhCn: 的其他种族有很深的研究，
linesEn: ...which is how I came to master your language.

linesZhTw: 『你的種族剛剛才聯合火魔神
與我們為敵，為何現在你又
linesZhCn: 『你的种族刚刚才联合火魔神
与我们为敌，为何现在你又
linesEn: Your kin were just fighting alongside the Fire Demon God against us.
Why would you want to join our ranks now?

linesZhTw: 『我族並不是故意要與你們為
敵，因為敵人以邪法控制了
王兄的神智，藉以命令我族
linesZhCn: 『我族并不是故意要与你们为
敌，因为敌人以邪法控制了
王兄的神智，藉以命令我族
linesEn: My people never wished to be your enemies.
The enemy used dark sorcery to corrupt my royal brother's mind...

linesZhTw: 的戰士來抵擋你們的攻勢。
我看穿這一點之後，敵人便
假王兄之手將我監禁起來，
linesZhCn: 的战士来抵挡你们的攻势。
我看穿这一点之后，敌人便
假王兄之手将我监禁起来，
linesEn: ...forcing him to command our warriors to hold you back.
When I uncovered their plot, they used my brother to lock me away.

linesZhTw: 還好你們阻止了他們，不然
整個惡魔族可能會就此滅亡
linesZhCn: 还好你们阻止了他们，不然
整个恶魔族可能会就此灭亡
linesEn: Thank goodness you stopped them, or the demon race would have faced total annihilation.
I see. How much do you know about our enemy?

linesZhTw: 『我相信他們和古代人的遺跡
以及黃金城絕對有關連，他
們可能是從附近的遺跡來到
linesZhCn: 『我相信他们和古代人的遗迹
以及黄金城绝对有关连，他
们可能是从附近的遗迹来到
linesEn: I am certain they are linked to the ancient ruins and the Golden Castle.
They likely crossed into this world through the ruins nearby.

linesZhTw: 這個世界的，所以當務之急
是經由本地的通道前往遺跡
linesZhCn: 这个世界的，所以当务之急
是经由本地的通道前往遗迹
linesEn: Our most urgent task is to take the passage to the ruins before they can summon more reinforcements.
Very well. Then you shall be our guide!
With pleasure! Let us make haste!
